lines.text: This is Earth One. One clear idea in every video, in plain words.
Our main story: how information evolved on this planet.
It began inside living bodies. Then it learned to travel in stories, marks, songs, print.
Information lives in words, so we teach words too: one sentence, five languages.
Two shows. One promise: every video teaches one clear idea about this planet.
